select s.item_id, s.item_code, s.item_name, s.specification, s.unit_of_measure, s.unit_name, sum(ifnull(s.quantity_onhand, 0)) as quantity_onhand, sum(ifnull(s.quantity_reserved, 0)) as quantity_reserved, sum(ifnull(s.quantity_onhand, 0) - ifnull(s.quantity_reserved, 0)) as quantity_available, count(1) as item_kind_count, (select i.min_stock from md_item i where i.item_id = s.item_id and i.del_flag = '0' limit 1) as min_stock, (select i.max_stock from md_item i where i.item_id = s.item_id and i.del_flag = '0' limit 1) as max_stock from wm_material_stock s
s.del_flag = '0' and s.item_id = #{itemId}
and s.item_code like concat('%', #{itemCode}, '%')
and s.item_name like concat('%', #{itemName}, '%')
and s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
and ifnull(s.quantity_onhand, 0) > 0
group by s.item_id, s.item_code, s.item_name, s.specification, s.unit_of_measure, s.unit_name order by s.item_id asc

select s.warehouse_id, s.warehouse_code, s.warehouse_name, sum(ifnull(s.quantity_onhand, 0)) as quantity_onhand, sum(ifnull(s.quantity_reserved, 0)) as quantity_reserved, sum(ifnull(s.quantity_onhand, 0) - ifnull(s.quantity_reserved, 0)) as quantity_available, count(distinct s.item_id) as item_kind_count from wm_material_stock s

select t.*, (case when t.min_stock > 0 and t.quantity_onhand < t.min_stock then 'LOW' else 'HIGH' end) as warning_type from ( select s.item_id, s.item_code, s.item_name, s.specification, s.unit_of_measure, s.unit_name, sum(ifnull(s.quantity_onhand, 0)) as quantity_onhand, sum(ifnull(s.quantity_reserved, 0)) as quantity_reserved, sum(ifnull(s.quantity_onhand, 0) - ifnull(s.quantity_reserved, 0)) as quantity_available, ifnull((select i.min_stock from md_item i where i.item_id = s.item_id and i.del_flag = '0' limit 1), 0) as min_stock, ifnull((select i.max_stock from md_item i where i.item_id = s.item_id and i.del_flag = '0' limit 1), 0) as max_stock from wm_material_stock s where s.del_flag = '0' group by s.item_id, s.item_code, s.item_name, s.specification, s.unit_of_measure, s.unit_name ) t where (t.min_stock > 0 and t.quantity_onhand < t.min_stock) or (t.max_stock > 0 and t.quantity_onhand > t.max_stock) order by t.item_code asc
